title: nettrace_3gpp_32_423: Replace strstr-based session tag parsing with XML
description:
Replace the fragile manual string searching in nettrace_parse_session_tag()
with proper libxml2 parsing. The old implementation used strstr() and
pointer arithmetic to find stime, idType, and idValue attributes in raw
buffer data, which could match substrings in attribute values, break on
unusual whitespace or XML entities, and had no bounds checking.

The new implementation:
- Finds the opening tag boundary and any <ue .../> child element
- Builds a well-formed XML fragment and parses it with xmlParseMemory
- Extracts attributes using the standard xmlNodeListGetString API
- Properly frees all allocated XML resources

Update both call sites (nettrace_read and nettrace_seek_read) to pass
available buffer length for bounds safety.

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)
